Read CAMELS-PE Annual Land-Cover Series

Source: R/land_cover.R
read_land_cover.Rd

Reads the annual land-cover series (1985-2024) of the CAMELS-PE catchments, derived from MapBiomas Peru, Ecuador and Colombia. Land cover is available at two levels:

read_land_cover(
  level = c("class", "subclass"),
  gauge_id = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  format = c("wide", "long"),
  path = get_camels_path()
)

Arguments

level

Character string. Either "class" or "subclass". Default is "class".

gauge_id

Character vector or NULL. Optional gauge identifiers used to filter the series. If NULL, all catchments are returned.

years

Numeric vector or NULL. Optional years to keep, for example 2000:2024. If NULL, all years are returned.

format

Character string. "wide" returns the table as stored in the dataset (one row per catchment and year, one *_perc column per class or subclass). "long" returns one row per catchment, year and class or subclass, with the names and codes of the legend and a perc column.

path

Character string. Optional path to the CAMELS-PE root directory. If not provided, the path previously defined with set_camels_path() is used.

Value

A tibble with the annual land-cover percentages of each catchment.

Details

  • "class": six aggregated classes (forest, agricultural area, natural non-forest formation, non-vegetated area, water and not observed), the same classes used in land_cover_attributes.csv.

  • "subclass": the MapBiomas subclasses (e.g. dry forest, pasture, scrubland, mining, glacier).

Use read_land_cover_legend() to see how subclasses are grouped into classes, and read_dictionary(category = "land_cover") to inspect variable descriptions.

The series are read from 02_attributes/land_cover_class_annual.csv and 02_attributes/land_cover_subclass_annual.csv. Percentages refer to the catchment area. In the class table, water_perc includes glaciers.

In long format, the class level returns the columns gauge_id, year, class_code, class and perc; the subclass level also returns subclass_code, subclass and mapbiomas_id.

Examples

path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "sample_camels_pe",
  package = "RCamelsPE"
)

# Annual classes, as stored in the dataset
lc_class <- read_land_cover(
  level = "class",
  path = path
)

# Annual subclasses for one catchment since 2000, in long format
lc_sub <- read_land_cover(
  level = "subclass",
  gauge_id = "PE_212900",
  years = 2000:2024,
  format = "long",
  path = path
)

head(lc_sub)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 8
#>   gauge_id   year subclass_code    subclass  class_code class mapbiomas_id  perc

#> 2 PE_212900  2000 dry_forest       Dry fore… forest     Fore…            4 0.013
#> 3 PE_212900  2000 mangrove         Mangrove  forest     Fore…            5 0    
#> 4 PE_212900  2000 flooded_forest   Flooded … forest     Fore…            6 0    
#> 5 PE_212900  2000 planted_forest   Planted … agricul    Agri…            9 0    
#> 6 PE_212900  2000 pasture          Pasture   agricul    Agri…           15 0
